name: Doumoto Mizuki
source:
"This is destiny, you know~" 

 A girl who loves fortune telling. She decided on entering the swimming club due to a fortune. She's always upbeat and never loses heart.
[From [url=http://alicesoft.wikia.com/wiki/]Alice Soft wiki[/url]]
